responsibility: Implements late name-resolution diagnostics: it analyzes failed or ambiguous path, lifetime, label, and associated-item resolution in the late resolver, derives context-aware typo/import/elision/shadowing suggestions, constructs error messages and notes, and records selected fallback lifetime resolutions to suppress cascading errors.
same_name_distinction: This diagnostics file is specific to the late-resolution visitor: its code handles body-level and type-driven failures such as associated item lookup, path resolution in expressions/types, label resolution, and lifetime elision/shadowing, including recording fallback lifetime resolutions. Unlike the top-level `diagnostics.rs`, it does not cover early import/macro/privacy diagnostics or `use`-insertion placement, but instead relies on richer late semantic context.
